output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is directly assigned to the balanceOf[target], without checking if it exceeds the maximum value of uint256. If initialSupply is large, attackers can mint arbitrary large amount of tokens to any target address.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function checks if balanceOf[msg.sender] < _value, but does not check if balanceOf[_to] + _value < balanceOf[_to], allowing attackers to overflow the balance of _to, and take complete control of _to's assets.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function checks if balanceOf[msg.sender] < amount, but does not check if balanceOf[this] += amount overflows, allowing attackers to overflow the contract's balanceOf[this], and steal funds.
